ownership.quote: InstaVM ... Production control plane for AI agents

stage.note: No press coverage, funding announcement, Crunchbase/PitchBook profile, or YC listing found (Crunchbase org page 403s with no cached data; ycombinator.com/companies/instavm 404s; Bing/Google searches for "InstaVM" + funding/seed/Y Combinator return no relevant results). Careers page describes a small remote (India) team with open junior roles and no mention of investors or a funding round, consistent with either a bootstrapped or very early/unannounced pre-seed company, but nothing confirms either stage.

note: InstaVM (instavm.io) is a Firecracker microVM sandbox/agent-infrastructure product run by a small, apparently India-remote team (careers page lists a single Developer Relations internship in Remote India/Bengaluru and refers to 'the founders', plural, but does not name them). Its most visible public presence is GitHub (org 'instavm': coderunner, tarit, murmur, manim-studio, skills) and a company blog with several well-received Hacker News posts (one blog post hit 1143 points on HN). No TechCrunch/Bloomberg/press coverage, no Crunchbase/PitchBook/Tracxn profile content, no YC or other accelerator listing, and no investor names or revenue figures were found in ~15 minutes of searching (DuckDuckGo blocked by bot-check, Google/Bing returned no relevant hits, Crunchbase org page returned 403). Treat funding/ownership/revenue here as unresearched rather than confirmed-absent; a buyer wanting certainty should check Crunchbase/PitchBook directly (behind paywalls) or contact the company.
